Here is a 150 to 250 word exam answer explaining five network devices based on the provided excerpts:

**Key Term:** Switch [p. 2]
A switch forwards a frame only to the port of the destination MAC address, facilitating communication between devices on a network. It operates at the data link layer and is crucial for efficient data transmission. [p. 2]

**Key Term:** Bridge [p. 2]
A bridge connects two LAN segments and filters traffic using MAC addresses, improving network performance and security. It operates at the data link layer, enhancing network reliability and speed. [p. 2]

**Key Term:** Router [p. 2]
A router forwards packets between different networks using IP addresses, ensuring data is correctly routed across various network boundaries. It operates at the network layer, playing a vital role in inter-network communication. [p. 2]

**Key Term:** Hub
A hub forwards every incoming signal to all ports, making it a simple but inefficient network device. It operates at the physical layer, lacking filtering capabilities. [p. 1]

**Key Term:** Repeater
A repeater regenerates a weak signal so it can travel further, enhancing network connectivity in environments with poor signal quality. It operates at the physical layer, crucial for extending network reach. [p. 1]

No additional example or code is needed as the answer is self-contained and covers all required points.
